items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: Oh, this is Debbie Bennett. And I'm doing a research paper on the origin of jazz.

ctx.x: And you are listening to Let's Talk It Over with your moderator, Joseph Collada. And our two guests this morning, Mr. Johnny Wiggs of Johnny Wiggs and the New Orleans Kings and Mr. Dick Allen of Tulane University. They're talking about that great New Orleans music, and you're on the air with them now. Go right ahead, please.

Oh, this is Debbie Bennett. And I'm doing a research paper on the origin of jazz. And I've heard so many different stories about it, I don't know which one to believe. I've heard that the Negroes had brought about jazz. And I heard a gentleman on the air a little while before me about a Tom Brown. And I was wondering if I'm...
You want to know what's the right scoop?
